truthful_status_note: All 12 supported positives are verified against one qualified backend: a dedicated QEMU-KVM Ubuntu 24.04.4 VM (own kernel and systemd, non-root account uid 1000, rootless Podman 4.9.3) whose eleven isolation controls are demonstrated by the probe battery, including host-kernel-truth binding of the nested user namespace. Backend receipt sha256:99b6bf972189160fe5a3a3b1efa2b9b286b355a75e3af41041a7db7be7ac8a8b. Each case holds a three-sequence A1/B/A2 ledger (single-token typed intervention across four delta kinds: path.prepend, env.value, mount.source, argv.token) whose failure signatures, frozen oracle results, and intervention diffs are independently re-derived by fixtures/lib/evidence-verifier.mjs before verified status is accepted. DEV-NATIVE-003 additionally pins its compiling runtime (official Node 22.22.1, digest-verified external artifact); DEV-RUNTIME-001 selects between official Node 24.15.0 and the image Node 22.23.2 as digest-verified external artifacts. The four remaining cases are Host-Observe-only by design (DEV-OOS-001 Windows, DEV-OOS-002 macOS, DEV-NEG-001/002 hard negatives) and stay implemented with their platform smokes; they never receive A1/B/A2 ledgers. S0 aggregate metrics beyond verified counts are tracked in docs/VALIDATION.md.
